output.summary: KEP-536 proposed a generic, label-based topology-aware routing for Services (e.g. node, rack, zone, region), with hard or soft topology requirements enforced by kube-proxy and kube-dns/coredns. The KEP was replaced by KEP-2433 Topology Aware Hints.
output.rationale: The motivation was to generalize the earlier node-local service requests so that locality can be defined by any node label (the "topology key"). The KEP was implementable from 2020-12-16 and was replaced from 2021-05-04. The recorded replacement is KEP-2433 Topology Aware Hints, but the sources do not give the reason for the replacement.
output.outcome_reason: The kep.yaml record says KEP-536 is replaced by KEP-2433 Topology Aware Hints. The sources do not state why it was replaced.

alternatives.option: Node-local service routing only, as in the earlier requests (kubernetes/kubernetes#7433 and PR #28637)
alternatives.why_not: The proposal says the node-local case alone is not enough and that a more generic way should be figured out.

evidence.quote: Figure out a generic way to implement the "local service" route, say "topology aware routing of service".
But, this document proposes that not only the particular "node-local" user case should be taken care, but also a more generic way should be figured out.
Routing decision is expected to be implemented by kube-proxy and kube-dns/coredns for headless service.

supersession_claims.quote: KEP-536 is replaced by KEP-2433 Topology Aware Hints
